sentences.text: The US has ordered all artificial intelligence (AI) technology from the Chinese firm DeepSeek to be removed from most government systems.
sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.text: The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) has banned all use of DeepSeek within civilian government agencies, and any technology built with the aid of its AI models.
sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.text: As a powerful AI model that is open source - meaning it is free to access and less expensive to use - DeepSeek has been seen as a disruptive force in the ongoing AI technology race.
sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.text: While the DHS notice did not detail the exact security concerns surrounding DeepSeek, the White House has this year criticised AI firms from China.
sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.text: The DHS, DeepSeek, and the Chinese embassy in Washington DC have been contacted for comment.
sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.text: The DHS made the order public on Monday, but the ban took effect from the end of July.
sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.text: The order is specific to civilian agencies, including the Department of the Treasury, the Department of State and the Department of Justice.
sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.text: However, agencies within the Department of Defense are excluded.
sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.text: The ban follows criticism of Chinese AI from the Trump administration, and from American firms.
sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.text: White House tech lead Michael Kratsios wrote earlier this year in an internal memo that "malicious exploitation" of American AI firms had been occurring, mainly by rival firms in China.
sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.text: Anthropic and OpenAI, both of which are poised to list on the public stock market in the coming months, have also claimed to have had their AI models essentially copied by some Chinese AI firms, including DeepSeek.
sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.text: US president Donald Trump has made clear that he sees China as the key US rival when it comes to development of AI, something he sees as crucial to the future of the country.
sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.text: DeepSeek has grown in popularity since its initial public release in 2025, with models being in such demand that the company's servers have gone down at times.
sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.text: While DeepSeek's free chatbot app is one of the most downloaded apps in the Apple App Store rankings, its AI models are also used by US tech companies.
sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.article_title: US bans China's DeepSeek from government in race for AI dominance

sentences.text: UK smartphone users could benefit from new payment, ticket and travel apps if Apple widens access to its contactless payment tech, the competition watchdog says.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) also wants the fees Apple charges firms to use its contactless tech to be "substantially lower".
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: It believes the iPhone maker's current fees and charges are "blocking" financial technology firms and others from innovating and growing - and is consulting on proposals it believes would cause these fees to fall.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: Apple maintains that widening access could undermine security, and that its current arrangements do not stop innovation.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: Nearly 2 in 5 payments are now contactless, the watchdog said, with nearly 60% of people using digital wallets - with Apple's the most popular in the UK.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: In a statement Apple told the BBC that the current arrangements had permitted developers in the UK and around the world to securely offer contactless transactions directly within their apps, for everything from in-store payments and transit passes to car keys and event tickets.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: "This solution enables developers and banks to create innovative products and services for their customers and facilitates competition between wallets, while ensuring users' sensitive data remains protected by the highest security standards".
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: "We do not believe the CMA should require Apple to adopt an approach with lower privacy and security protections.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: We will continue to engage constructively to reach an outcome that is in the best interest of our users." Last year Apple warned UK regulators against following the same path as the EU which forced it to open up a range of its technologies to rivals.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: However, the CMA argued that, unlike the EU, it is focused on ensuring the interoperability of particular aspects of Apple's tech, such as digital wallets and watches.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: The proposed measures would force Apple to grant access to apps that make payments via a widely used alternative contactless technology standard, called Host Card Emulation (HCE), which the firm does not currently permit in the UK.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: The UK is one of the world's leading fintech hubs, the CMA said, generating more than  £214 billion in turnover and supporting more than 360,000 jobs.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: But Apple's fees and rules contactless payments are restricting growth and innovation, it argued.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: Changes could enable the development of a wide range of new products, such as account-to-account payments, digital IDs, travel passes and digital keys, it claimed.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: The regulator said moves to open up the tech in the EU had resulted in the creation of new businesses.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: In the six months since the EU forced Apple to widen access to its tech, an alternative payment app Vipps launched, followed by PayPal, Klarna, Curve, and BBVA.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: Apple argues however that the these new apps could easily have been launched prior to the changes.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: But in the UK not a single firm has launched a wallet-type product to compete with Apple's the watchdog argued.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: The CMA said it was not proposing to set the price and terms Apple could demand for use of its devices contactless tech, but the effect of its plans would be that prices would fall.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: Sarah Cardell, Chief Executive of the CMA said it had been told that high fees, strict terms, and technical restrictions relating to Apple's contactless technology made it too difficult for challengers to innovate and compete.
sentences.article_title: UK asks Apple to widen access to its payment tech

sentences.text: "By removing barriers to entry, we can help create the conditions for brilliant British businesses with great ideas to develop new products and services," she said.

sentences.text: Elon Musk's SpaceX and artificial intelligence giant Anthropic have pledged big financial giveaways as Big Tech firms come under pressure over the potential impact of AI on humanity.
sentences.article_title: Musk and Anthropic pledge public share giveaways

sentences.text: Musk said on Monday that he would give one of his shares at his rocket company, which owns xAI, to every child in America next year.
sentences.article_title: Musk and Anthropic pledge public share giveaways

sentences.text: The billionaire's announcement came after Anthropic said it would commit 5% of its shares to a fund that will make donations for the "public good".
sentences.article_title: Musk and Anthropic pledge public share giveaways

sentences.text: Anthropic is laying the ground for a potential blockbuster stock market listing that could value the firm at more than $1tn (£750bn).
sentences.article_title: Musk and Anthropic pledge public share giveaways

sentences.text: SpaceX set the record for biggest initial public offering (IPO) in history in June, raising $85.7bn.
sentences.article_title: Musk and Anthropic pledge public share giveaways

sentences.text: The pledges come at a time when the AI industry is under intense scrutiny over safety concerns and fears about its impact on society and jobs.

sentences.article_title: Musk and Anthropic pledge public share giveaways

sentences.text: This will be the first of many." It came after he responded to Anthropic's public fund pledge with: "I recommend giving the shares directly to the public.

sentences.text: This is what I will be doing." Anthropic said none of the shares held in its Public Benefit Fund would be used for lobbying or political donations in the US or overseas.

sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: They do not stop even if the trip lasts for several hours.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: The faithful sometimes offer money to the preachers to support their endeavours.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: But a new law means this familiar practice could be coming to an end.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Anyone found preaching in public service vehicles faces up to eight months in prison, a fine of up to $52 (£39) or both.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: The new regulation, passed by parliament in May, and which has started to be enforced in recent weeks, targets preaching and hawking on vehicles while they are in motion, classifying both as a nuisance and citing the safety and comfort of passengers.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Boateng, a 61-year-old pastor at Gospel Light church, has been preaching on commercial vehicles leaving Neoplan station since 2023.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "I preach on commercial vehicles because not everyone is able to go to church on Sunday.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: There are a lot of passengers who need our message of salvation to repent from their sins.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: We even heal the sick on some buses," he told the BBC in Twi, a local language.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Wearing a clerical collared shirt, Boateng moves through rows of buses loading passengers before boarding one bound for Kumasi, Ghana's second-largest city.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: We speak to him before the bus departs to avoid breaking the law.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Some travellers listen closely as he delivers his message.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Others try to ignore him, browsing their phones, making calls or chatting among themselves.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "Some passengers are very happy with my message.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Some even say they have never heard the message in church, but through my preaching they now know it is in the Bible," he says.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Boateng Bismark James and his group start preaching at the bus station before boarding the vehicles The new rules have divided opinion.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Critics say preaching on moving vehicles is a nuisance and a safety risk, as it could distract the driver, while supporters argue that evangelism is a Christian duty and should be protected under the freedom of religious worship.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: One woman in her early 30s, who wishes to be identified as Chery Lokko, says she prefers to travel in peace. ''I don't like it because they are a nuisance.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Some of them spit saliva on you unconsciously, especially if you are seated not far from them, and they are a nuisance in terms of noise and saliva.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: I like my peace whenever I'm on public transport.'' In one video widely shared on social media recently, a passenger on a minibus is seen angrily confronting a pastor attempting to board.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "Get down, I say get down," he shouts.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: But in this devout country, ranked among the most religious in the world , external , others say evangelism on public transport is an important way of reaching people who may not attend church.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Bernice Nartey, a passenger travelling to Kumasi, says pastors should be allowed to preach, but only with passengers' consent.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "The preaching sometimes helps people to repent.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: For instance, if someone is going through a stressful situation, the message of the pastor can give the person renewed hope," she says.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Boateng says he was shaken by the regulation and wants religious preachers to be given an exemption.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "We are very worried, because most pastors here depend on preaching to take care of their families through the monetary gifts offered by passengers," he says.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "The government should allow us to preach on the buses and alight when it is exiting Accra," he adds.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: For Boateng, preaching is not only a religious calling but also an important source of income.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "I have been able to take care of my children's education.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Preaching on commercial buses was first prohibited in Ghana in 2012, with offenders facing up to 30 days in prison.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: But enforcement was weak and so the practice remained common, particularly on buses.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: The new law beefs up the penalties for those that flout the ban.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Preachers using megaphones can also often be seen and heard at Ghana's lorry parks and markets but they are not affected by the ban.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: The Christian Council of Ghana did not respond to the BBC's request for a comment but Rev Enoch Paul Hayes, a senior pastor at one of the biggest churches in Ghana, the International Central Gospel Church, tells the BBC he does not think the new rules infringe on religious freedom.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: He urges his fellow pastors not to break the law, saying they should find other ways of spreading their message.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "There is social media as an alternative outlet, where the same message can reach thousands of people," he says.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Kgomotso Mathekga says a lack of male role models is fuelling violence against women in his neighbourhood "I witness men hitting women all the time," says Kgomotso Mathekga, 30.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "Especially when they are both drunk." "I once had an argument with my girlfriend," he admits, "and I grabbed and slapped her." Mathekga is speaking frankly during a gathering of men aimed at helping reduce the high levels of violence against women in South Africa.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The meeting is held in a narrow street in a Johannesburg informal settlement known as Organic Market.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: It is a maze of corrugated metal shacks and unpaved roads, close to Alexandra township.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "Now I feel pain," Mathekga continues.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We broke up and I no longer see my child.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: I feel like I've contributed to the problems in South Africa, instead of being the gentleman that I know I am." At a nearby tavern, a group of men have pulled their chairs into a circle in the dust.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: At the centre stands Itumeleng Stephen Tamaga, known locally as Bra Steve.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The group clap and cheers.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "Listen guys," Bra Steve says.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We must stand together to fight against gender-based violence and femicide." Bra Steve is the local organiser of Father A Nation, a non-profit that works with men and boys to promote positive masculinity and help end violence against women.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The group's meeting comes as South Africa grapples with renewed anger over renewed cases of femicide and violence against women.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The discovery of the bodies of 12 women over three months, in the city of Ekurhuleni, near Johannesburg has reignited questions about the scale of what many people see as being a crisis of violence against women.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Bra Steve says: "We must restore dignity to the men around here" South Africa's President Cyril Ramaphosa has acknowledged that his government has not done enough and announced measures he hopes can make women feel safer.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The country has one of the highest murder rates in the world, with 5,427 people murdered between April and June this year alone.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: In that period, according to the South African Human Rights Commission, 569 women were killed, an average of six a day, and 1,052 others survived attempted murder.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: A report in 2022 by the Human Sciences Research Council found that more than 35% of South African women experienced physical or sexual violence, many from their own intimate partners.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: For Bra Steve, part of the solution to the crisis is helping men to understand the issue and take responsibility for their actions.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We are a lost generation," he says.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We must restore dignity to the men around here." Amongst the group of men outside the tavern is Zizipho Mtwesi, the project co-ordinator of Father A Nation.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Reflecting on recent weeks, he says more should be done.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The latest measures announced by Ramaphosa, including better street lighting and a review of unsolved cases , are too little, he says, and too late.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "When I think about all of these recent murders in Johannesburg, I get angry.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Why do we have to wait for this to happen for us to act?" He looks around and gestures at the meeting.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We are trying to reach men before things like these murders happen again." Craig Wilkinson tells the group to "choose what kind of man you want to be" Craig Wilkinson is the founder of the group.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We get men to talk, to process their feelings," he explains.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "And as they do, this healing takes place.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: And the second phase is teaching and training positive masculinity.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We ultimately hope that this will eliminate the scourge of gender-based violence." He stands up, moving into the centre of the group, calling out to the men.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "You as a man are a powerful force for good," he tells them.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "You choose what kind of man you want to be.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Women need to be safe." Father A Nation operates across South Africa, teaching healthy masculinity and running training programmes across dozens of schools and colleges.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Mystery surrounds the spate of murders which has sparked South Africa's latest moment of soul-searching about the safety of its women.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Police have not ruled out potential links between some of the Ekurhuleni deaths but have not said they are investigating a serial killer.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Suspects in some of the cases have appeared in court.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: But the spate of deaths has sparked new concerns and in Organic Market some women are more fearful than ever.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Outside a nearby shack Linkie listens with interest as she cleans clothes in a large metal bucket.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We are not safe when we are outside our place," she says.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We are afraid when we see a car behind us when we walk.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: What if this guy's going to kidnap me or do something to me?" It is a feeling shared by many women here.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: In the local hair salon, sporting a mane of thick pink braids, is Providence Maseko.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: She comes to the door to speak to Bra Steve.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: This video can not be played Women held a memorial run in Johannesburg after the discovery of Moselakgomo's body "Safety here is very bad," she says, "Maybe you are the serial killer.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: How do I know who to trust?" Bra Steve laughs.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We must talk about these things," he urges.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "Come to our meetings and we can learn to trust each other." Maseko tells me that she now takes an e-hailing taxi everywhere in the hope that it is safer.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Back at the tavern, the men's meeting is wrapping up.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "As we try to stop gender-based violence," says Zizipho, "each and every man needs to know that they need to play a part in this.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "And if they wouldn't allow these things to happen to their own daughters or own mothers, they mustn't allow it to be done to someone else's daughter, which is their wives or their girlfriends." Mathekga is impressed with what he has heard.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "I would love them to keep on practising what we have learned, because we no longer have role models," he says.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "Our fathers and our uncles, they are there in prison.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: We must now become role models and help make this country better." Twelve women have been killed in one part of South Africa since July.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma has been crowned king of Uganda's Tooro kingdom.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The new monarch has long been a familiar face in the East African nation, where for many he was known not as the heir to the throne, but as a storyteller: a long-serving anchor and editor at the state broadcaster.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: But the 56-year-old - now King Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma Nyabongo I - has become the subject of media attention himself as his rise to the Tooro throne sparked controversy and widespread reactions beyond the country.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Tooro is one of Uganda's four main officially recognised historical kingdoms.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: For the last 31 years, it had been headed by King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV, who was once known as a "boy king", after ascending to the throne as an infant.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Oyo became king in 1995 at the age of just three, following the death of his father.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Then the world's youngest monarch, he ruled until he died last month from cancer, aged just 34.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: This video can not be played King Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma Nyabongo I promised to unite his people at his coronation The coronation is a day for celebration, involving traditional practices that started at midnight.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma has had to perform various ceremonies and walk about 4km (2.5 miles) to the official Karuziika royal palace where he has now been crowned.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The Tooro kingdom's Information Minister Charles Mwanguhya told the BBC Focus on Africa podcast that a mock fight would follow his crowning, to signify that kingship does not come easy.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma would then be blessed by members of the royal Babiito clan, he said.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: But his selection was far from straightforward.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: According to tradition, a recognised son of the late king should have succeeded him.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Close members of the royal family said Oyo had left a young son and a will with instructions that the child should be next on the throne.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: But the son has never been revealed to the public and nor was he recognised by the committee of 21 Babiito clan members who choose the king and eventually selected Kijanangoma.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The late King Oyo was never publicly married, and little is known about his wife or their son.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Nonetheless his mother, Queen Best Kemigisa, argued that the late king's will ought to have been respected.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: However, the royal succession committee ignored her wishes, insisting their selection process was conducted in accordance with Tooro customs and traditions.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The new king has thus found himself at the centre of a succession dispute, with Kemigisa and her close relatives unhappy with the outcome.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The late King Oyo's mother has expressed her pain over the succession row Kemigisa referred to Kijanangoma's selection as the "announcement of a second king" being "made after the will of King Oyo was read to members of the royal family".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: "As a mother, that was extraordinarily painful," she said, describing celebrations for the next king taking place "only metres from where my son's body lay".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The queen later said Oyo's son, who was in the US state of Texas, had been due to return home but that could not happen amid a "tense and polarised succession dispute".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: "No child should be placed in circumstances where returning to his father's homeland could mean being drawn into hostility and conflict," Kemigisa asserted in a post on X.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: But according to the Tooro kingdom's information minister, the son being talked about "hasn't been presented anywhere, which means there is a growing acceptance that sad as it may be, King Oyo didn't leave a son behind".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: While King Oyo inherited the crown from his father, Mwanguhya told the BBC "the crown has moved to a different line within the ruling clan".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: A king must come from the Babiito clan, specifically the lineage of King George David Matthew Kamurasi Rukidi III, according to royal palace sources.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma and the late King Oyo are cousins.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Both are grandsons of Rukidi III, the 11th king, or Omukama, who ruled the Tooro kingdom from 1928 to 1965.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: After he was formally announced, Kijanangoma promised that the palace would be open to the people, while vowing to focus on unity and development.
